column_notes.references.local_x: Derived exterior-local coordinate; RTree uses global position.
column_notes.references.local_y: Derived exterior-local coordinate; RTree uses global position.
column_notes.statics.flags: Record-header flags for several base-object signatures.
column_notes.statics.bounds_valid: Defaults to 0; default bounds alone do not establish measured bounds.
column_notes.lights.flags: LIGH/DATA flags, distinct from the record header.
column_notes.conversion_cache.plugin_path: TEXT PRIMARY KEY without declared NOT NULL. SQLite rowid-table PK rules permit NULL.
column_notes.scripts.properties_json: Current parser output; not complete script/gameplay interpretation.

column_notes.landscape_texture_grasses.gras_id: Code-level GRAS link; no SQLite FK.

fields.label: Record-header flags
fields.declaration: MCP F0002 labels header bit 0x800 Initially Disabled. Those flag names are declaration evidence.
fields.projection: The complete u32 header value is stored in references.header_flags; individual bits are not decoded.
fields.native: The selected loader scan does not establish initial visibility or parent-chain evaluation.
fields.unknown: Record-type-specific bit meanings and runtime enable effects remain unverified.

fields.label: Base record link
fields.declaration: FormID; Mutagen calls this Base.
fields.projection: NAME becomes references.base_form_id; the current helper falls back to 0 when absent.
fields.native: RVA 0x2de330 reads the ID, resolves it through TESDataHandler::GetForm and checks a bound object. Local shard-0018.c:41997-42018.
fields.unknown: Bound-object validation is static evidence; subsequent consumers were not audited.

fields.label: Placement transform
fields.declaration: Sources describe six position/rotation floats.
fields.projection: Six floats become pos_x/y/z and rot_x/y/z; missing elements currently fall back to 0.
fields.native: The DATA branch exists at RVA 0x2de330 (local shard-0018.c:41920 onward). Destination/zeroing details do not establish an exact native value mapping.
fields.unknown: This pilot does not establish distance or angle units, or runtime transform parity.

fields.label: Reference scale
fields.declaration: Scalar named Scale.
fields.projection: Typed scale with current default 1.0.
fields.native: RVA 0x2de330 calls TESFile::ReadData for XSCL. Local shard-0018.c:42028-42033.
fields.unknown: Downstream scaling behavior has not been independently traced.

fields.label: Radius override
fields.declaration: Mutagen names Radius.
fields.projection: First four bytes become references.radius_override as little-endian f32.
fields.native: REFR dispatches XRDS to RVA 0x15b040, which reads the payload and invokes a helper. Local shard-0018.c:42086-42090; shard-0011.c:21230-21240.
fields.unknown: Current exporter comments (lines 688-693) assert Creation units and light-reference use. This is a source-comment claim; this pilot has no independent native helper or final-consumer proof.

fields.label: Enable parent, flag byte and retained tail
fields.declaration: Parent FormID (bytes 0-3), flag byte (byte 4), three bytes xEdit labels unused (bytes 5-7). Declared bits 0/1 mean opposite-of-parent and Pop In.
fields.projection: The remapper handles XESP only at exactly 8 bytes across the 11 placed kinds. The parent ID is remapped, or cleared to 0 if invalid; malformed XESP subrecords are removed. SubrecordXESP widens only byte 4 to u32 and the exporter stores that value in enable_parent_flags. Bytes 5-7 remain in the serialized subrecord and are excluded from the flag column.
fields.native: RVA 0x15b040 passes the parent ID to RVA 0x165660, removes an entry for zero, creates/updates it for nonzero and writes the following single flag byte. Local shard-0011.c:20925-20943,27595-27640.
fields.unknown: The native meaning of retained bytes 5-7 and parent-chain effects remain unobserved. F0010 reports those bytes often nonzero; its historical corpus lacks an input-manifest hash. F0011 is a historical FormID link-remap diagnostic, not evidence of current remap failure or flag width.

fields.label: Primitive extra
fields.declaration: xEdit labels primitive types 3/4 Portal Box/Line; Mutagen names 0-3 None/Box/Sphere/PortalBox.
fields.projection: No typed column; parsed tag/payload remains in references.data and records.data.
fields.native: RVA 0x15b040 passes parsed values to RVA 0x212710. Types 1-4 construct box, sphere, plane and line objects; other values return no primitive. Local shard-0011.c:20769-20800; shard-0015.c:17203-17336.
fields.unknown: Names differ between sources and native constructors. Collision and visibility consumers remain untraced.

fields.label: Four light-extra values
fields.declaration: xEdit describes four floats; Mutagen names a light-data structure.
fields.projection: No typed column; tag/payload remains serialized.
fields.native: RVA 0x15b040 reads four values, byte-swaps when needed, and calls four setters in order. Local shard-0011.c:20393-20421; shard-0012.c:1643-1920.
fields.unknown: The native name-to-value mapping and final render effects remain provisional.

fields.label: Emittance source link
fields.declaration: Emittance FormID in the source models.
fields.projection: The 4-byte XEMI link is remapped across the 11 placed kinds, or cleared to 0 if invalid; malformed lengths are removed. The normalized tag/payload is serialized with no typed emittance column.
fields.native: The reader stores ExtraEmittanceSource through a setter; zero removes the entry. Local shard-0011.c:20423-20432; shard-0012.c:69-103.
fields.unknown: Link storage does not establish its final render effect.

fields.label: Cell record-header flags
fields.declaration: Record header and DATA subrecord are separate flag inputs.
fields.projection: cells.flags stores record.flags, the header u32.
fields.native: The selected DATA branch updates a different native cell-flags member.
fields.unknown: Do not interpret cells.flags as CELL/DATA flags.

fields.label: Cell editor identifier
fields.declaration: Source editor identifier.

fields.label: Cell subrecord flags
fields.declaration: xEdit requires a 16-bit flags value; Mutagen declares a non-null two-byte enum.
fields.projection: Not typed by extract_cell_info; the payload remains in cells.data and records.data.
fields.native: RVA 0x2b82b0 has short one-byte and wider-payload paths. Bits select cell-state/LAND allocation and cleanup branches. Local shard-0018.c:10604-10663.
fields.unknown: The one-byte path has no target-corpus occurrence evidence. Source widths and values need a census.

fields.label: Grid coordinates and unresolved tail
fields.declaration: Signed X/Y, then xEdit one-byte Land Flags plus three unused bytes; Mutagen describes a four-byte flags enum.
fields.projection: Only bytes 0-7 become signed grid_x/grid_y. The tail remains in parsed payload data.
fields.native: RVA 0x2b82b0 has a 12-byte path, length-sensitive endian handling and a one-byte store. Local shard-0018.c:10730-10754.
fields.unknown: The trailing field and source width disagreement remain unresolved; no typed tail column exists.

fields.label: Interior cell lighting
fields.declaration: xEdit makes members after the first eleven optional; Mutagen describes extended lighting fields.
fields.projection: No lighting members materialized; raw parsed payload only.
fields.native: RVA 0x2b82b0 reads a 0x60-byte payload into a lighting object with byte-order handling. Local shard-0018.c:10808-10818.
fields.unknown: Occurrence lengths, optional-tail rules and downstream lighting consumers remain unverified.

fields.label: Lighting template link
fields.declaration: xEdit permits LGTM or NULL; Mutagen marks the link non-nullable.
fields.projection: The 4-byte LTMP link is remapped on CELL and WRLD, or cleared to 0 if invalid; malformed lengths are removed. The normalized payload remains serialized with no typed template column.
fields.native: RVA 0x2b82b0 consumes LTMP and clears eight bytes in an adjacent member. Local shard-0018.c:10869-10879.
fields.unknown: The inspected native load path does not show resolution. Native nullability and later initialization remain open. F0011 is a historical FormID link-remap diagnostic, not evidence of current remap failure or nullability.

glossary.meaning: Four-byte record tag such as REFR. Multiple source model classes may share one signature.
Plugin file-header signature; counted separately from the 133 plugin-record candidates.
Tagged payload inside a major record, such as REFR/XESP. Its framing is separate from its decoded value.
Group envelope and hierarchy in the source plugin. The current parsed record projection flattens group context.
Extended-length subrecord framing. Current serialized parsed tags/payloads do not preserve that original encoding.
Plugin-local or resolved record identity, depending on context. It does not identify a physical source occurrence by itself.
One definition at a physical position/ordinal in a specific immutable source. Planned archive provenance retains it separately.
Plugin that owns the resolved local record ID. A later plugin may provide its winning override.
Effective record selected by override/deletion resolution. Earlier occurrences are not retained in the current winner database.
Serialized per-record version. It differs from executable version, source-tool commit and database schema version.
What a pinned tool source model names or describes. It does not prove retail applicability or native behavior.
What a pinned executable load path reads, stores or dispatches. Runtime effects require additional observation.
Fields or parsed payloads produced by the inspected current converter. Partial typed data does not establish a complete schema.
SQLite virtual spatial index. Each shown virtual table creates three implementation shadow tables, excluded from the logical table catalog.
PRAGMA table_info notnull flag. PK behavior is separate: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY aliases rowid and can auto-assign on NULL; other rowid-table PKs can allow NULL unless declared NOT NULL.
Planned Mudcrab-owned data contract and interpretation registry. Current SQL columns are not its completeness boundary.
